info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Payments Payments Capture-v3-spec
info.description: The Payments Capture API facilitates the finalization of payment transactions by capturing authorized payment amounts. It is designed for merchants and payment processors to ensure secured completion of payment processes. Through this endpoint, users can submit payment details and manage transaction lifecycle events efficiently. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial institutions seeking to integrate seamless payment functionalities into their systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to capture a payment that has been authorized. Use this to finalize the transaction and complete the payment process for the customer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to capture a payment that has been previously authorized. It requires the necessary payment details and identifiers to successfully process the capture.

201.description: Payment capture was successful and the resource has been created.
